description: Under internal ccc, if \(p\) forces a ground name to be an ordinal, there is an internally countable ground set \(C\) containing its value under every generic through \(p\). Replacement inside the ground model collects the unique ordinal labels of the deciding antichain. If \(p\) forces the value below a ground ordinal \(\delta\), the same \(C\) is a subset of \(\delta\).
